name: agi-workforce
description: AI pair programming in VS Code, run by the AGI CLI on your machine with local models, your own provider keys, or AGI Cloud.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: API endpoint, CLI path, model boundary, auto-apply, startup connection, inline completion, and tier settings cannot be overridden by workspace settings in untrusted workspaces. Until the workspace is trusted, the local AGI CLI runtime is not started (so chat, agent runs and session history are unavailable), and inline completions are off.

virtualWorkspaces.description: AGI Code runs the AGI CLI against a checkout on disk, so agent mode, git, terminal commands and local developer sessions need a real filesystem. Open the repository locally, or through a remote, dev container or WSL window.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with AGI Code
walkthroughs.description: Understand workspace scope, task handoffs, review, autonomy, and trust boundaries before your first developer session.

steps.title: Install the AGI CLI
steps.description: Chat and developer sessions run on the AGI CLI in this environment. [Install AGI CLI](command:agi-workforce.installCli)

steps.title: Work in this repository
steps.description: AGI developer sessions stay scoped to the open workspace and local runtime. [Open AGI Chat](command:agi-workforce.chat)

steps.title: Follow background work from the IDE
steps.description: Cloud tasks started on any device show their state, age and pending approvals in the Cloud tasks list, and Continue in the Cloud hands this branch to a cloud session. [Show Cloud Tasks](command:agi-workforce.showCloudTasks)

steps.title: Turn intent into a reviewed change
steps.description: Attach workspace files, ask AGI to implement a TODO, and inspect the native diff before accepting changes. [Open AGI Chat](command:agi-workforce.chat)

steps.title: Set autonomy and verify the boundary
steps.description: Review generated code and commands. The header names Local, BYOK, or Managed Cloud, and Account & Usage identifies the relevant plan owner. [Review Account & Usage](command:agi-workforce.showAccountUsage)

steps.title: Decide what AGI remembers
steps.description: Memory keeps short facts about you in your AGI Cloud account and sends them with your turns while it is on. [Open Memory](command:agi-workforce.memory)

agiWorkforce.model.description: Default LLM model. Run 'Code: Select Model' (cmd+shift+m) to pick from currently available providers.

agiWorkforce.cliPath.description: Path to the AGI CLI executable that owns workspace-scoped local developer sessions.

enumDescriptions: Queue messages sent during an active turn and start them in order after that turn finishes.
Steer the active turn with messages sent while it is running; conflicts visibly fall back to the next-turn queue.
agiWorkforce.composer.followUpBehavior.description: Default behavior when sending from the composer during an active developer turn. The key that sends with the other behavior once is Cmd/Ctrl+Enter, or Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+Enter when Cmd/Ctrl+Enter is the send key.

enumDescriptions: Enter sends. Shift+Enter adds a line.
Enter sends a one-line prompt. Once the prompt has several lines, Enter adds a line and Cmd/Ctrl+Enter sends.
Cmd/Ctrl+Enter sends. Enter adds a line.
agiWorkforce.composer.enterBehavior.description: Which key sends a prompt from the composer.

agiWorkforce.contextLines.description: Number of surrounding lines to include as context

agiWorkforce.editorContext.autoAttach.description: Attach the active editor file, the current selection and that file's problems to each chat turn. Every attachment shows as a removable chip in the composer before you send. A workspace setting can turn this off, but only your user setting turns it on.

agiWorkforce.respectGitIgnore.markdownDescription: Leave files that git ignores out of `@` file search, and send only the path of an ignored file that is open in the editor. Takes effect while `#search.useIgnoreFiles#` is also on. A workspace setting can turn this on, but only your user setting turns it off.

agiWorkforce.telemetryEnabled.markdownDescription: Send product usage events, such as stopping a response or accepting a suggested edit, to your AGI account when its [product analytics choice](https://agiworkforce.com/settings/privacy?from=vscode-extension) allows them. Also subject to VS Code's telemetry setting.

agiWorkforce.memory.enabled.description: Include the memory facts saved to your AGI account with chat turns. Turn this off to stop sending them without deleting them; Code: Memory keeps showing what is stored. Only your own user settings can change this. To keep memory off in one repository, folder or remote machine, set agiWorkforce.optOut.memory there.

agiWorkforce.optOut.memory.description: Keep memory off here. Set this in a repository, folder, dev container or remote settings file to stop saved memory facts going with chat turns from this place. It can only turn memory off, never on.

agiWorkforce.hoverEnabled.description: Show AGI Code quick actions on hover over identifiers

agiWorkforce.codeLensEnabled.description: Show AGI Code action lenses above every function and class. Off by default: the lenses render on every declaration in every open file, which competes with the editor's own lenses (references, implementations, test status). The same actions are always available from the right-click menu and the sidebar.

agiWorkforce.autoApplyFixes.description: Automatically apply AI-suggested fixes without showing a diff. Only your own user settings can turn this on. To keep it off in one repository, folder or remote machine, set agiWorkforce.optOut.autoApplyFixes there.

agiWorkforce.optOut.autoApplyFixes.description: Always show a diff before an AI fix is applied here. Set this in a repository, folder, dev container or remote settings file to turn off Auto Apply Fixes for this place. It can only turn the feature off, never on.

agiWorkforce.inlineCompletions.enabled.description: Send surrounding code to AGI Cloud for ghost-text inline completions. Sensitive files are excluded. Requires browser sign-in or an AGI API key. Only your own user settings can turn this on. To keep it off in one repository, folder or remote machine, set agiWorkforce.optOut.inlineCompletions there.

agiWorkforce.optOut.inlineCompletions.description: Keep inline completions off here. Set this in a repository, folder, dev container or remote settings file so no surrounding code is sent for completions from this place. It can only turn completions off, never on.

agiWorkforce.inlineCompletions.debounceM.description: Debounce delay in milliseconds before requesting inline completions (default: 300ms)

agiWorkforce.inlineCompletions.maxLength.description: Maximum character length for inline completion suggestions (default: 500)

agiWorkforce.agent.planMode.deprecationMessage: Use Code: Open Settings and choose Agent mode → Plan instead.
agiWorkforce.agent.planMode.description: Deprecated, use agiWorkforce.agent.mode instead. When true, maps to agent.mode = 'plan'.

enumDescriptions: Read and edit files without asking; running commands and changing git hooks or MCP settings still ask first.
Propose a plan before making edits.
Skip approval prompts for workspace/additional-directory, terminal, network-capable command, and configured MCP tool access. Selecting this requires a modal risk confirmation.
agiWorkforce.agent.mode.description: Default agent mode for new conversations. 'ask' confirms writes and commands, 'auto' reads and edits files without asking while running commands and changing git hooks or MCP settings still ask first, 'plan' proposes a plan before any edits, and 'bypass' skips all approval prompts only after explicit risk confirmation. A repository cannot set this: it is a user setting that also applies in remote windows, and Bypass Permissions is confirmed per workspace.

agiWorkforce.agent.effort.description: Reasoning effort for providers that support it (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google). Ignored when provider does not support an explicit effort axis. A user setting, so a repository cannot raise it, and it also applies in remote windows.

agiWorkforce.agent.thinking.description: Enable extended thinking for cloud-backed editor utilities such as Explain, Fix, diagnostics, and inline completion. This setting does not affect local @agi, sidebar, or editor developer sessions, whose reasoning effort is controlled by the Effort setting.

agiWorkforce.activateOnStartup.description: Start AGI Code background work (device heartbeat, plan lookup) as soon as the window opens. Off by default, so nothing leaves the machine until you open the AGI view, run an AGI command or reopen an AGI session.

agiWorkforce.useTerminal.description: Launch the AGI CLI in the integrated terminal instead of the native UI when you run Code: Open Chat.

scripts.package: pnpm run clean && node esbuild.js --production && node scripts/vsce-package.js package --no-dependencies
scripts.lint: node scripts/check-vscode-theme-tokens.mjs && eslint src --ext ts --cache --cache-strategy content --cache-location .cache/eslint --max-warnings=0
scripts.test:integration: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit && node esbuild.js --tests && node esbuild.js && node out/test/runTests.js
scripts.test:integration:vsix: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit && node esbuild.js --tests && node out/test/runTests.js
scripts.test:integration:package: pnpm run package && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit && node esbuild.js --tests && node out/test/runTests.js --vsix-package
scripts.prebuild: pnpm run clean && pnpm run typecheck
